findings.text: The old code escaped every ESC byte as ``. The new code only strips `ESC[...m` colour sequences, so other escapes such as `ESC[K`, `ESC[2J` or a bare ESC pass through as raw 0x1B in the JUnit XML. A test that prints `\033[K` then produces invalid XML that CI parsers reject.
